The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including CNC cutting, 3D design, welding, cutting, shaping, and finishing—all performed under one roof. Capabilities extend to architectural metalwork, custom railings and staircases, vehicle modifications, prototype builds, equipment repair and modification, and metal business signs. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

FAB402 serves business-to-business clients across industries such as lawn care, construction, and home building, as well as individual customers. A noted project includes a custom dump bed built for Summit Lawns, a lawn-care company, while testimonials reference work for a woodworking business and a personal Jeep modification.

The company emphasizes continuous improvement, transparency, and a flexible partnership model that accommodates both one-time orders and long-term relationships. It positions contract fabrication as a cost-efficient alternative to in-house production, allowing clients to focus on their core operations.

name: FPEC Corp.
old_description: FPEC is always looking for driven, dedicated operators, engineers, executives, and every skilled worker in between to join our family-owned and operated business. Since 1959, we’ve focused on taking care of our people, the same way we like to take care of our customers.
about:
FPEC Corp. was founded in 1959 by John H. Davison and Armond Villian in a small shed behind a lumberyard in Bellflower, California. The company, now headquartered in Springdale, Arkansas, remains family-owned and operated, currently in its third and fourth generations. The founders started the business after recognizing that food processors were left waiting for late equipment, stuck with underperforming machines, and struggling to get responsive service.

FPEC designs and manufactures food processing equipment and material handling systems for the meat, poultry, pork, beef, and pet food industries. Their product line includes grinders, tumblers, cookers, mixers, conveyors, lifts, dumpers, and automation solutions with custom control panels. The company emphasizes 100% stainless steel construction with precision welding for unibody strength. From its Arkansas facility, FPEC provides engineering, manufacturing, installation, and ongoing service including replacement parts and on-site technician support.

The company serves food processors nationwide, including poultry, pork, and beef operations as well as pet food manufacturers. Customers range from large poultry producers to smaller processors seeking integrated production lines from intake to packaging. Testimonials reference maintenance managers and plant personnel who value reduced downtime and easier maintenance.

FPEC differentiates itself by building its own controls for all equipment, enabling smoother startups, and by maintaining a long-term partnership model that includes responsive parts shipping and service. The founders' original vision—to challenge the status quo of late deliveries and poor service—continues to drive the company's engineering-first approach and commitment to American-made quality.

name: Fabco Manufacturing Inc
old_description: . was contracted by a customer to perform custom fabrication services and perform a manufacturability study on their wireless and radio frequency (RF) test equipment, reviewing and recommending design changes as we deemed necessary. The prototypes we provided were of superior quality and functionality, leading to a production contract with the customer. The project highlighted here is the stackable anechoic RF test enclosure, designed to provide a cost effective solution for the customer’s specific testing requirements. The enclosure is composed of 14ga and 16ga cold rolled steel, which is formed with shearing, punching, metal forming, TIG welding, grinding, and stud welding processes to meet the required contours. A protective zinc plating treatment and powder coating is applied, and the part was completed with hardware insertions. First article testing is carried out to ensure quality and accuracy, and we provide a certificate of compliance for documented conformity.
about:
Fabco Manufacturing Inc., a family-owned precision sheet metal fabrication and machining company, has operated from Hudson, Massachusetts since 1971. The business began by drawing on local skilled craftsmen dedicated to engineering and manufacturing quality products for customers.

Today the 30-person shop occupies 23,000 square feet of manufacturing and warehousing space, offering in-house shearing, punching, forming, TIG welding, grinding, stud welding, zinc plating, powder coating, hardware insertion, machining, and mechanical assembly. The company produces stackable anechoic RF test enclosures, hybrid solar aluminum energy collectors, cold-rolled steel exercise equipment, medical hematology and photo-acoustic devices, interactive touchscreen kiosks, luggage compartments, and lateral filing cabinets. It supports prototype through high-volume runs, leveraging Asian supplier alliances for large orders and Kanban programs for recurring demand, with new-part lead times up to six weeks.

Fabco serves medical equipment, test and measurement, electronics, furniture, contract manufacturing, capital equipment, and military sectors. Concrete projects include wireless/RF test enclosures for a wireless equipment maker, solar collectors for energy firms, exercise equipment for fitness brands, and chassis for medical diagnostic devices.

The company emphasizes a single-source model from design-for-manufacturability through first-article inspection and dock-to-stock delivery, targeting a zero-defect culture that has yielded an RMA rate below 0.5%. Its quality system follows ISO 9001, with random in-process audits and a corrective-action program that empowers every employee to flag quality concerns.

Family First Solar, based in Kapolei, Hawaii, has been installing solar energy systems since 2002. The locally owned and operated company was founded with a focus on keeping money in the local economy and giving back to the community.

The company provides full-service residential solar installation across Oahu, Maui, and Kauai, handling consultation, design, permitting with Hawaiian Electric (HECO), and installation. Its offerings include rooftop solar panels, solar air conditioning, solar water heaters, solar attic fans, battery storage using Simpliphi batteries, and the Power Shaver energy-saving system. To date, the firm has installed more than 6,500 systems.

Family First Solar serves homeowners seeking energy self-sufficiency and reduced utility bills. Its customer base is exclusively residential, with projects ranging from standard photovoltaic arrays to integrated solar-powered HVAC and water heating solutions.

The company distinguishes itself by performing all work in-house—from sales and procurement to installation and warranty service—eliminating the need for third-party repair contractors. It emphasizes its roots as an established Hawaiian business that prioritizes local economic retention and community involvement.

name: Finwave Semiconductor Inc.
old_description: Finwave Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company that uses innovative transistor designs and breakthrough process technologies to unlock the full potential of Gallium Nitride on Silicon (GaN-on-Si). Founded by prominent MIT innovators and driven by industry leaders, Finwave is shaping the future of RF Communications through revolutionary advancements in energy efficiency and performance for applications in markets such as Aerospace and Defense, mobile infrastructure, smartphones, medical devices, and cloud computing.
about:
Finwave Semiconductor, headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, traces its roots to 2012 when Cambridge Electronics was founded by MIT professor Tomás Palacios to commercialize GaN-on-Si research from his laboratory. The company rebranded as Finwave in 2022 to mark its transition from stealth development to commercial production.

As a fabless semiconductor company, Finwave designs RF switches and power amplifiers using its proprietary FinFET-based GaN-on-Si process. The technology has been scaled from 1 cm² research wafers to 8-inch production wafers, with manufacturing outsourced to silicon foundry partners. Finwave offers evaluation kits and conducts 100% wafer-level and packaged-device testing, including HTOL reliability stress screening.

Finwave’s devices target aerospace and defense, mobile infrastructure (5G/6G base stations), smartphones, satellite communications, automotive radar, medical equipment, and test & measurement applications. Customers include global distributors and OEMs seeking higher linearity, lower power consumption, and simplified digital pre-distortion.

The company differentiates itself through a patented device-level linearization technique that reduces electron-trapping memory effects and enables novel power combining, delivering higher intrinsic linearity than conventional GaAs or GaN approaches. This allows more efficient power amplifiers at backoff and simpler DPD algorithms, reducing overall system energy use.
